institution: Predictive Model for Birth Delivery Mode
subtitle: Supporting Dr. Rubana Hoque Chowdhury's PhD research

highlights.text: View my work for this research on GitHub:

highlights: Worked as a research assistant to Dr. Rubana Hoque Chowdhury on her PhD research in an iterative loop: reviewing the supplied literature, implementing the proposed methods in code, then jointly experimenting on and refining the resulting models.

Achieved 99% accuracy for cesarean vs. vaginal delivery prediction and 94% accuracy for spontaneous vs. induced delivery classification, using machine learning and geometric feature extraction on Electrohysterogram (EHG) signals.
Re-implemented and validated methods from prior published EHG studies, and built the analysis and figures behind two of her publications and her annual PhD committee reviews.

Supplied experimental evidence throughout her PhD journey, from proposal defence through dissertation submission and final defence, and continue the collaboration on her post-PhD research (2026 to present).

institution: Bengali Keyword Extraction from Bengali Blogs (Transformer-Based Approach)
subtitle: Supervised by Dr. Muhammad Ibrahim Khan
highlights: Built a comprehensive Bengali blog dataset of 9,012 annotated posts and proposed a transformer-based dual-encoder architecture, achieving an 84% F1@10 score.
Ran a comparison analysis against existing keyword-extraction methods to benchmark the proposed approach.
